options.distractor: begin 是短暂动词，不能接 for ten minutes
for ten minutes 要用完成时

questions.explanation: begin 换成 be on（上映中），用 has been on。

questions.stem: He ____ the Party for five years.

options.distractor: join 是短暂动词，不能接 for five years
for five years 要用完成时

questions.explanation: join 换成 be in（在……里），用 has been in。

questions.stem: The old man ____ (die) for three years.

options.distractor: die 是短暂动词，不能接 for three years
for three years 要用完成时

questions.explanation: die 换成状态 be dead，用 has been dead。

options.distractor: leave 是短暂动词，不能接 since 2010

questions.explanation: leave 换成 be away from（离开的状态），用 have been away from。

options.text: I have had this pen for two years.
The meeting has been on for an hour.
options.distractor: 正确：begin 换成 been on

options.text: He has bought the car for five years.
She has kept the book for a week.

questions.explanation: buy 不能接时间段，应改为 He has had the car for five years。

questions.stem: — How long ____ you ____ this bike? — For three years.

options.distractor: buy 是短暂动词，不能接 how long / for
答语是 for three years，要用完成时

questions.explanation: 问“拥有多久”用 How long have you had…（不用 bought）。
